press_references.value: Variant Bio Launches Inference, the World's First Agentic AI Genomic Drug Discovery Platform

product_launches.description: Variant Bio launched Inference, an AI-driven genomic drug discovery platform that integrates large-scale public and proprietary multi-omic data and autonomous agentic analyses, now offered to pharmaceutical research partners.

overview_description.description:
Variant Bio is leveraging the power of human genetic diversity to discover new therapeutics. The company's focus is to identify individuals and populations around the world who are extreme outliers for traits of medical relevance and to use innovative sequencing and analytic approaches to identify genes and pathways linked to these traits.

Variant Bio was founded in 2018 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington.

product.name: Genomic Partnerships
product.description: Collaborative research programs with communities, biobanks, academic institutions, healthcare organizations, and other research partners to obtain ethically governed genomic and health data.

product.name: Data Generation
product.description: Collection and generation of genomic, health, phenotype, and biospecimen data for human genetics research and therapeutic target discovery.

product.description: A computational platform associated with Variant Bio for analyzing human genetic data and supporting genomic research and drug discovery.
